WITH matched_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    t.observstation,
    t.bandusagepct,
    COALESCE(o.lunarstage, 'missing') as phase
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    phase,
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM matched_telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY phase, observstation
),
phase_bandwidth AS (
  SELECT 
    phase,
    AVG(station_avg) as avg_bandwidth
  FROM station_avgs
  GROUP BY phase
),
telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    phase,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM matched_telescopes
  GROUP BY phase
)
SELECT 
  tc.phase,
  pb.avg_bandwidth,
  tc.telescope_count,
  tc.telescope_count::FLOAT / SUM(tc.telescope_count) OVER () as fraction
FROM telescope_counts tc
LEFT JOIN phase_bandwidth pb ON tc.phase = pb.phase
ORDER BY tc.phase;

SELECT
